/*
 * ringbuf.c - a fixed-size ring buffer of bytes.
 *
 * Fixture for the token estimator tests: plain C with a header-style
 * section, macros, pointer arithmetic and a small self-test.
 */
#include <assert.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#define RINGBUF_MIN_CAPACITY 16u
#define RINGBUF_OK            0
#define RINGBUF_ERR_NOMEM    (-1)
#define RINGBUF_ERR_FULL     (-2)

typedef struct ringbuf {
    uint8_t *data;
    size_t   capacity;   /* always a power of two */
    size_t   head;       /* next position to write */
    size_t   tail;       /* next position to read  */
} ringbuf_t;

static size_t round_up_pow2(size_t n)
{
    size_t p = RINGBUF_MIN_CAPACITY;
    while (p < n) {
        p <<= 1;
    }
    return p;
}

int ringbuf_init(ringbuf_t *rb, size_t capacity)
{
    assert(rb != NULL);
    rb->capacity = round_up_pow2(capacity);
    rb->data = (uint8_t *)malloc(rb->capacity);
    if (rb->data == NULL) {
        rb->capacity = 0;
        return RINGBUF_ERR_NOMEM;
    }
    rb->head = rb->tail = 0;
    return RINGBUF_OK;
}

void ringbuf_free(ringbuf_t *rb)
{
    if (rb == NULL) {
        return;
    }
    free(rb->data);
    memset(rb, 0, sizeof(*rb));
}

static inline size_t ringbuf_used(const ringbuf_t *rb)
{
    return rb->head - rb->tail;
}

static inline size_t ringbuf_avail(const ringbuf_t *rb)
{
    return rb->capacity - ringbuf_used(rb);
}

int ringbuf_write(ringbuf_t *rb, const void *src, size_t len)
{
    const uint8_t *bytes = (const uint8_t *)src;
    size_t mask = rb->capacity - 1;
    size_t i;

    if (len > ringbuf_avail(rb)) {
        return RINGBUF_ERR_FULL;
    }
    for (i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        rb->data[(rb->head + i) & mask] = bytes[i];
    }
    rb->head += len;
    return RINGBUF_OK;
}

size_t ringbuf_read(ringbuf_t *rb, void *dst, size_t len)
{
    uint8_t *out = (uint8_t *)dst;
    size_t mask = rb->capacity - 1;
    size_t n = ringbuf_used(rb);
    size_t i;

    if (len < n) {
        n = len;
    }
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        out[i] = rb->data[(rb->tail + i) & mask];
    }
    rb->tail += n;
    return n;
}

#ifdef RINGBUF_SELFTEST
int main(void)
{
    ringbuf_t rb;
    char scratch[64];
    size_t got;

    if (ringbuf_init(&rb, 20) != RINGBUF_OK) {
        fprintf(stderr, "out of memory\n");
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }
    assert(rb.capacity == 32);
    assert(ringbuf_write(&rb, "hello, ", 7) == RINGBUF_OK);
    assert(ringbuf_write(&rb, "world", 5) == RINGBUF_OK);
    assert(ringbuf_write(&rb, scratch, sizeof scratch) == RINGBUF_ERR_FULL);

    got = ringbuf_read(&rb, scratch, sizeof scratch - 1);
    scratch[got] = '\0';
    printf("read %zu bytes: \"%s\" (0x%02x..0x%02x)\n", got, scratch,
           (unsigned)scratch[0], (unsigned)scratch[got - 1]);

    ringbuf_free(&rb);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
#endif /* RINGBUF_SELFTEST */
